description: This file defines the SoapError class used for handling SOAP error information within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for setting error details based on external definitions and retrieving error data as an array.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: A class representing SOAP error details, including error name, number, and description, with methods to set and retrieve error information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SoapError instance with a default 'no_error' state.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets the error details based on an error name, referencing external error definitions.

methods.name: get_soap_array
methods.description: Returns the error details as an associative array.

methods.name: getFaultCode
methods.description: Returns the error number as the fault code.
